evaluation.calibration: Unchanged sigmoid three-fold training-only calibration, ensemble=False, complete pipeline inside calibrator
evaluation.cv: Four fixed pipelines, three training-only folds, raw-margin AUROC; save held margins and scaler statistics for reconstruction

export_rule.selection: Choose exactly one of the three new models by largest mean original-text training CV before consulting validation. Exact ties prefer fewer numeric features, then c60_length, c60_richness, c60_length_richness. Never try a runner-up if this candidate fails.

feature_geometry: Original L2 C60 TF-IDF unchanged. Each numeric block: document-local extractor then StandardScaler, fitted inside the complete CV/calibration pipeline. FeatureUnion weights char=1, length=1/sqrt(2), richness=1/sqrt(3). No final row normalization. Expected training squared norm of each numeric block is nonconstant_columns/block_dimension, not necessarily 1. No block weight or C search.
limitations: This is development research after inspected validation/public feedback, not an untouched test.
Incremental predictive information is conditional on this explicit two-feature length block and chosen model geometry; no causal independence or complete removal of length dependence is established.
Short documents use shorter MATTR windows; all three richness statistics can remain length-dependent.
Adding numeric blocks changes geometry and effective regularization; fixed C does not equate model capacity.
Bootstrap intervals condition on fitted models and this split, omit training variation and selection adjustment; secondary contrasts are descriptive.
Typography conditions were already inspected; no independent OOD robustness claim follows.
No credible source groups are currently established; this run does not invent a grouped split.
primary_comparison: richness_given_length: c60_length_richness minus c60_length on original validation text
purpose: Four-group character/length/lexical-richness ablation authorized after negative C tuning and a separate quote intervention
richness_features: MATTR: mean unique-token fraction over all sliding windows of min(50,n); zero for n=0
Unigram Shannon entropy with natural log divided by log(n); zero for n<2
Repeated-bigram fraction: (n_bigrams - n_distinct_bigrams)/n_bigrams; zero for n<2
secondary_comparisons: each new model versus historical WC120 incumbent
stopping_rule: Complete 12 CV fits, three new calibrated 8000-row fits (reuse checksum-guarded historical C60), four-group analysis and WC120 diagnostic reference, independent verification; optionally export one eligible 10000-label candidate. No further feature, window, C, block-weight or split changes after scores.
tokenization: Lowercase Unicode letter-only tokens using (?u)\b[^\W\d_]+\b; digit-containing and underscore-containing tokens are excluded; apostrophes split words
